known_limitations: Expense-ratio fee facts MEASURED for 11/22 eligible legs (GLD/IAU/SLV via SSGA+iShares anchors; DBO/DBC/PDBC/DBA via Invesco JSON; CORN/SOYB/WEAT/CANE via Teucrium JSON-LD). 11 legs NOT_MEASURED fail-closed (BAR, GCC, SGOL, SIVR, PPLT, PALL: issuer pages 404/403 for non-browser clients; USO/USL/UNG/UGA/CPER: USCF official pages HTTP 200 but fee cell empty in static HTML, client-side injected). Every attempt is recorded with URL+status+sha256 in fee_facts.json; no value guessed, no third-party aggregator substituted.
Roll (1984) cross-check not identifiable (cov >= 0) on 7/22 legs and recorded as None with the measured covariance (DBC, GCC, PALL, PDBC, SIVR, SLV, USO) -- disclosed, never fabricated.

Tracking-divergence proxy exists only where SAME-UNDERLYING pairs exist in the P0 census: 9 legs (gold BAR/GLD/IAU/SGOL, silver SLV/SIVR, crude DBO/USL/USO); 13 legs fail-closed WITHOUT the proxy (no same-underlying pair).

Dispatch hint 'gold: GLD/IAU/SGOL/SIVR' was corrected by the measured census: SIVR is a SILVER leg (cot code 084691); the fourth GOLD leg is BAR (cot code 088691). Groups are derived programmatically from p0_market_pairs.json (equal cot_market_code, purity pure, both legs ETP-eligible), never hardcoded.

Share-base (reverse-split) boundaries exist in the RAW vendor series (IAU 2010+2021, BAR 2019, SLV 2008, USO 2020, plus GCC/PDBC/UNG/PALL/PPLT/WEAT/DBC events). CS windows straddling a boundary are excluded; Roll deltas across a boundary are excluded; cross-sectional divergence is measured on the split-continuous adj_close reconstruction surface (RAW close remains the trading surface). Without this, GLD/IAU divergence would have reported a +7.8%/yr split artifact; with it, -12.4bp/yr vs a 15bp/yr stated fee gap (economic sanity anchor pinned in tests).

CS daily estimates clip at zero on a majority of windows (median full-spread 0.0 bps on all legs) -- documented Corwin-Schultz behavior on EOD data under overnight gaps; the STRESS constant (p90) is the contract constant per plan section 5.

Instrument drag (expense + measured tracking proxy) is booked as a tier-independent daily accrual on the NET books; the stress tier scales only the transaction component. Semantics are pinned by hand-computed tests; tier-2.0 is PRIMARY.
No scored computation, no expectancy/outcome numbers, no proposals anywhere in P1 (kernel book_metrics deliberately exposes count/total only).
incidents: CLOCK_BUG_FIXED_IN_LANE: weekly_decision_grid initially anchored the decision session on the Tuesday report date (yielding 2026-06-10 instead of the Monday after the Friday release). Caught by the real-calendar anchor test against committed GLD sessions before commit; fixed to anchor on the release instant's calendar day; decision session for report 2026-06-09 is 2026-06-15.

DIVERGENCE_SURFACE_FAULT_FOUND_AND_FIXED: first measurement run reported GLD/IAU tracking divergence +7.8%/yr (RAW closes corrupted by IAU reverse splits) and USO Roll corrupted by the 2020 share reconstitution. Root-caused to share-base discontinuities in RAW closes; added split_events boundary detection (adj/close factor-level change >= 5%), boundary-excluded CS windows and Roll deltas, and moved cross-sectional divergence to the split-continuous adjusted surface. GLD/IAU now -12.4bp/yr, SIVR/SLV +20.3bp/yr (both match stated-fee-gap expectations).
